people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: The horn of Moab has been cut off, and his arm is broken,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith Jehovah.
